column1: 1|17|General principles|面试的五个原则|如何准备量化面试，并把自己的思考清楚地表达出来？|How should you prepare for and communicate during a quantitative interview?|把知识准备与现场沟通分开思考。|Separate preparation from communication.|扎实掌握数学、金融和编程基础；提前练习典型问题。先听清条件，必要时澄清，再把关键推理说出来。信息不完整时提出合理假设并说明它，而不是默默补上条件。|Build strong fundamentals in mathematics, finance and programming. Practice beforehand, listen carefully, clarify the assumptions and explain the important reasoning steps. When information is missing, state a reasonable assumption explicitly.

2|19|Screwy pirates|海盗分金|五名理性海盗分100枚金币，半数及以上赞成即可通过，否则提案者出局。最资深海盗如何保命并拿到最多金币？|Five rational pirates divide 100 coins. A proposal passes with at least half the votes; otherwise its proposer dies. What should the most senior pirate offer?|从两名海盗开始倒推，比较每个人在下一轮能拿多少。|Work backward from two pirates and price each vote against its next-round payoff.|按资历从高到低记作A、B、C、D、E。两人时D独吞；三人时C给E一枚；四人时B给D一枚。于是五人时C、E在下一轮都得0，A各给他们1枚就能连同自己凑到3票，分配为98、0、1、0、1。关键是严格多于下一轮所得才会换来赞成票。|Label the pirates A through E in decreasing seniority. With two pirates D keeps everything; with three C buys E's vote for one coin; with four B buys D's vote. Thus C and E would get zero if A died. A offers (98,0,1,0,1), obtaining three votes. A bribe must improve the recipient's next-round payoff.

2|20|Tiger and sheep|老虎与羊|100只老虎和1只羊在岛上，吃羊的老虎会变成羊。老虎首先确保生存，羊会被吃吗？|There are 100 tigers and one sheep. A tiger that eats the sheep becomes a sheep. Survival comes first. Will the sheep be eaten?|从1只、2只、3只老虎开始看奇偶规律。|Start with one, two and three tigers and track parity.|1只虎时会吃；2只虎时谁吃谁就会被剩下的虎吃，所以都不吃；3只虎时吃后留下2只虎与1只羊，因而安全。归纳可得：虎数为奇数会吃，为偶数不会吃。100为偶数，羊安全。|One tiger eats; two tigers abstain because the eater would be eaten; three tigers can eat because the resulting two-tiger position is safe. Induction alternates the outcome: an odd number eats and an even number abstains. With 100 tigers the sheep survives.

2|21|River crossing|过桥与手电筒|四人过桥分别需要1、2、5、10分钟，一次最多两人，必须携带唯一的手电筒。最少多久？|Four people take 1, 2, 5 and 10 minutes to cross. At most two cross together with the only torch. What is the minimum total time?|让两个最慢的人一起走，安排快的人送回手电。|Send the two slowest together and use the fastest as couriers.|1和2先过，用2分钟；1返回，用1分钟；5和10一起过，用10分钟；2返回，用2分钟；1和2再过，用2分钟。总计17分钟。若总让1分钟的人护送每位慢者，会花19分钟。|Send 1 and 2 across (2), return 1 (1), send 5 and 10 (10), return 2 (2), then send 1 and 2 (2). The total is 17 minutes. Pairing the slowest travelers avoids paying the ten-minute crossing separately twice.

2|21|Birthday problem|生日的逻辑推断|候选生日为3月4/5/8日、6月4/7日、9月1/5日、12月1/2/8日。一人知道月份，另一人知道日期，通过三次声明推断生日。|Use the candidate dates and the three knowledge statements in the original question to determine the birthday.|每句话都在删除与该说法不相容的候选项。|Each knowledge statement eliminates incompatible candidate dates.|知道月份的人确信知道日期的人不知道，排除包含唯一日期7或2的6月、12月。知道日期的人随后知道答案，排除剩下重复的5日，只剩3月4日、3月8日、9月1日。知道月份的人此时也能确定，因此只能是9月1日。|The month-holder knows the day-holder cannot identify the date, ruling out June and December, which contain unique days 7 and 2. The day-holder then identifies the date, eliminating day 5. The remaining dates are March 4, March 8 and September 1. Only September lets the month-holder identify a unique date, so the answer is September 1.

2|22|Card game|红黑牌的不变量|每次翻两张牌，红红归你，黑黑归庄家，混色丢弃；你红牌更多才赢。值得付钱玩吗？|Turn over pairs from a standard deck. You keep red pairs, the dealer keeps black pairs, and mixed pairs are discarded. Can you finish with more cards?|记住红牌总数等于黑牌总数。|Track the equal totals of red and black cards.|每次混色丢弃都同时删去一红一黑，剩下红、黑数量仍相等。最终你拿到的红牌必然与庄家黑牌一样多。严格多才算你赢，因此不可能赢，不应支付正入场费。|Discarding a mixed pair removes exactly one red and one black card. Equality of the remaining totals is invariant. At the end your red total equals the dealer's black total, so you never win under the strict-win rule and should pay no positive entry fee.

2|23|Burning ropes|烧绳计时|两根绳子各烧完需1小时，燃烧速度不均匀。如何量出45分钟？|Two ropes each take one hour to burn but burn unevenly. How can you measure 45 minutes?|两端同时点燃，烧完时间会减半，不需要均匀燃烧。|Lighting both ends halves the remaining burn time without requiring uniform speed.|同时点燃第一根两端、第二根一端。第一根烧尽时经过30分钟；此时第二根还需单端烧30分钟。再点燃它的另一端，剩余部分15分钟烧完。合计45分钟。|Light both ends of the first rope and one end of the second. When the first finishes, 30 minutes have elapsed and the second has 30 minutes of burn time left. Light its other end; it finishes in 15 more minutes, for a total of 45.

2|23|Defective ball|十二球称重|12颗球中有一颗异常，未知偏重还是偏轻。如何用天平3次找出异常球并判断轻重？|One of twelve balls is either heavier or lighter. How can three balance-scale weighings identify it and its type?|每次称重有三种结果，需要同时管理球号和偏重、偏轻两种假设。|A weighing has three outcomes. Track both ball identity and heavy/light hypotheses.|共有24种异常假设，3次最多有27种结果，信息量足够但还需可实现的决策树。先称1—4与5—8；平衡则嫌疑在9—12，否则嫌疑为一侧偏轻或另一侧偏重。第二次重新组合嫌疑球并引入正常球，使各结果至多剩3种假设；第三次区分。完整分支见原书图2.1，不能仅用27大于24当成构造证明。|There are 24 hypotheses and at most 27 three-weighing outcome strings. Weigh 1–4 against 5–8. Balance restricts suspicion to 9–12; imbalance restricts it to light balls on one side and heavy balls on the other. Recombine suspects with known normal balls so each second-weighing branch has at most three hypotheses, then distinguish them. The full constructive tree is in Figure 2.1; the information bound alone is not a strategy.

2|25|Trailing zeros|阶乘的末尾零|100!末尾有多少个零？|How many trailing zeros does 100! have?|一个零来自一对2和5，哪个素因子更稀缺？|Each zero needs a factor 2 and a factor 5. Count the scarcer factor.|2的因子多于5，所以只数5。5的倍数贡献20个，25的倍数再贡献4个，125以上没有。共24个。一般公式为Σ floor(n/5^k)。|Factors of two are more abundant, so count factors of five: floor(100/5)+floor(100/25)=20+4=24. Higher powers contribute zero. In general the count is the sum of floor(n/5^k) over positive k.

2|25|Horse race|二十五匹马|25匹马、5条赛道，无计时器，如何用最少比赛找出最快3匹？|Twenty-five horses race on five lanes without a stopwatch. How many races identify the fastest three?|先建立组内偏序，再淘汰至少已有三匹马更快的候选者。|Rank within groups and eliminate any horse already known to have three faster rivals.|先分5组各赛一次；第6场让5位组冠军比赛，按A、B、C、D、E排序。A1最快，仍可能占第2、第3的只有A2、A3、B1、B2、C1，让它们进行第7场即可。总共7场。|Run five heats, then race their winners. Name the groups A through E by that result. A1 is fastest overall. Only A2, A3, B1, B2 and C1 can still be second or third; race them once. Seven races suffice, with every other horse eliminated by three known faster horses.

2|26|Infinite sequence|无限幂塔|若无限幂塔x^(x^(x^…))收敛到2，x是多少？|If the convergent infinite power tower x^(x^(x^…)) equals 2, what is x?|去掉最外层后，剩余幂塔的极限仍为2。|The inner tower has the same limit as the entire tower.|设极限y=2，由自相似得到y=x^y，故2=x²，正实数解x=√2。还要核对收敛性，不能对任意x都假设无限幂塔存在；√2在实数幂塔的收敛范围内。|Let the limit be y=2. Self-similarity gives y=x^y, so x²=2 and the positive solution is √2. The limit assumption matters: not every positive base yields a convergent tower. This base lies in the real convergence range.

2|26|Box packing|三维装砖|能否把53块1×1×4砖沿盒子的网格方向放进6×6×6盒子？|Can 53 axis-aligned 1×1×4 bricks fit inside a 6×6×6 box?|体积足够未必能装下；尝试把2×2×2小块交替染色。|Volume is insufficient as a proof. Color alternating 2×2×2 blocks.|盒子包含27个2×2×2块，两色分别14块、13块。每根沿网格的1×1×4砖对两色各占2单位体积。较少颜色仅有13×8=104单位体积，最多支持52根砖，因此53根不可能。这个论证依赖题目中的网格摆放设定。|Checkerboard-color the 27 blocks of size 2×2×2. One color occupies 13 blocks, hence volume 104. Every grid-aligned brick occupies two units of each color, so at most 104/2=52 bricks fit. Thus 53 cannot fit under the grid-alignment assumption.

2|27|Calendar cubes|日历方块|给两个六面方块标数字，使它们能显示01到31，允许交换左右，怎么标？|Label two six-faced cubes so they can display every date from 01 through 31, allowing the cubes to swap places.|11和22要求两块都有1和2；6可以翻转成9。|Both cubes need 1 and 2; a rotated 6 can serve as 9.|两块都标0、1、2；一块余下面标3、4、5，另一块标6、7、8。把6倒过来当9。这样12个面覆盖所有所需日期。|Label one cube 0,1,2,3,4,5 and the other 0,1,2,6,7,8. Rotate 6 to represent 9. Duplicating 0,1,2 makes the repeated and single-digit dates possible while the remaining faces cover the other digits.

2|28|Door to offer|真假守卫|两扇门分别通往录用与出口，一名守卫说真话，一名说假话。只问一个是非问题，怎么选？|One door leads to an offer and one to an exit. One guard tells the truth and one lies. What single yes/no question identifies the correct door?|把另一个守卫的回答嵌套进问题。|Nest the other guard's answer inside the question.|问任一守卫：“另一位守卫会说你守的门通往录用吗？”若答是，选另一门；若答否，选该守卫身后的门。无论问到谁，嵌套一次谎言都把真相反转。|Ask either guard: “Would the other guard say your door leads to the offer?” If yes, choose the other door; if no, choose this door. The nested answer contains exactly one lie, so it reverses the truth in either case.

2|29|Message delivery|双锁传信|不安全的快递会偷走未上锁箱内的东西。双方各有锁和唯一钥匙，如何传送文件而不传钥匙？|A courier steals anything sent in an unlocked box. Each party has a padlock and its only key. How can a document be delivered securely?|允许同一箱子同时挂两把锁。|Allow two padlocks on the same box.|你上自己的锁寄出；对方不拆你的锁，再加自己的锁寄回；你拆自己的锁再寄出；对方用自己的钥匙开箱。三次运输全程至少有一把锁。这里依赖箱子能挂两锁以及讨论范围内的快递威胁模型。|Lock the box and send it. The recipient adds a second lock and returns it. Remove your lock and send it again; the recipient removes theirs. Three deliveries suffice, and the box is never unlocked in transit. The construction assumes the box supports two locks and the stated courier model.

2|29|Last ball|最后一颗球|袋内有红蓝球，每次取两球：同色放回蓝球，异色放回红球。初始14颗红球，最终球是什么颜色？|Repeatedly replace two same-colored balls by a blue ball and two differently colored balls by a red ball. Starting with 14 red balls, what is the final color?|观察红球数量的奇偶性。|Track the parity of the number of red balls.|红球数量每次减少0或2，所以始终为偶数。每步总球数减少1，最后只有一球；它不可能是红球，否则红球数为1。故最后为蓝球。|The red count changes only by zero or minus two, preserving even parity. The total count falls by one each step. With one ball left the red count cannot be one, so the final ball must be blue.

2|30|Light switches|四个开关|房内一个灯泡，房外四个开关，仅一个有效。可以提前操作，最少进房几次能识别？|A bulb inside a room is controlled by one of four outside switches. How many room visits identify the switch?|除了亮灭，还可以利用灯泡余热；先确认灯泡会发热。|Use heat as well as light, assuming a bulb with detectable retained heat.|先让A、B开足够久，再关B、开C，D始终关。立刻进房：亮且热对应A，灭且热对应B，亮且冷对应C，灭且冷对应D。一次即可；若灯泡不产生可辨余热，该策略不成立。|Warm the bulb using A and B, then switch B off and C on, leaving D off. Enter promptly: lit/hot means A, dark/hot B, lit/cold C, dark/cold D. One visit suffices if heat is detectable and switching is timed appropriately; an effectively heatless bulb invalidates this construction.

2|31|Quant salary|不公开工资求平均|8人想知道平均工资，但不想直接透露个人工资，怎样计算？|Eight people want their average salary without directly disclosing individual salaries. How can they compute it?|先用随机数遮住第一人的工资，再依次累加。|Mask the first salary with a random offset and circulate a running sum.|第一人取随机数R，加上自己的工资后传给第二人；每人加上自己的工资，最后传回第一人。第一人减去R，公布总额并除以8。这是题目假设下的简单遮蔽法，不保证抵御参与者串通。|The first person adds a random mask R to their salary and passes the sum around. Everyone adds their salary. The first person subtracts R from the returned total and divides by eight. This hides direct disclosure under the puzzle's assumptions but is not secure against colluding participants.

2|31|Coin piles|盲分硬币|1000枚硬币中恰有20枚正面朝上，蒙眼无法辨别正反。如何分成两堆，使正面数相同？|Among 1,000 coins exactly 20 show heads. Blindfolded, split them into two piles with equal numbers of heads.|可以翻转一整堆，不必识别哪枚朝上。|Flip an entire selected pile rather than trying to identify individual heads.|任取20枚作第一堆，假设其中有h枚正面，则另一堆有20−h枚正面。把第一堆全部翻转，它也恰有20−h枚正面。两堆总枚数无需相同。|Choose any 20 coins. If h are heads, the other pile contains 20−h heads. Flip all 20 chosen coins; that pile now also has 20−h heads. The piles need equal head counts, not equal total sizes.

2|32|Mislabeled bags|全部贴错的水果袋|三个袋子分别装苹果、橘子、混合水果，标签全部错误。最少取几个水果能识别所有袋子？|Three bags contain apples, oranges and a mixture. Every label is wrong. How many fruit draws identify all bags?|从标为“混合”的袋子抽一个，它一定不是混合袋。|Draw from the bag labeled “mixed”; it must be a pure bag.|只需一次。若从“混合”袋抽到苹果，则该袋是纯苹果；标“橘子”的袋不能是橘子，也不能是已确定的苹果，只能是混合；最后一袋是橘子。抽到橘子时对称处理。|One draw suffices. If the “mixed” bag yields an apple, it is the all-apple bag. The bag labeled “oranges” must then be mixed because both its label and the apple identity are excluded. The last bag is oranges. Reverse the roles if the first draw is an orange.

2|33|Wise men|贤者与翻杯子|50人被随机单独召见，屋内只有一个初始朝下的杯子可翻转。如何确认所有人都来过？|Fifty people are called individually in random order and can flip a shared cup initially in a known position. How can they certify everyone has visited?|指定一个计数者，其余人每人只发一次信号。|Designate one counter; everyone else signals exactly once.|49名普通人只在杯子处于初始方向且自己从未发信号时翻杯。计数者每见杯子反向，就复位并加1，数到49即可宣布。若每人都会反复被召见，完成概率为1；不是任意有限时间内必然完成。|Each of the 49 non-counters flips the cup from the initial position only once in their life. The counter resets each observed signal and increments a count. At 49, everyone has visited. Under repeated random selection this completes almost surely, rather than within a fixed guaranteed deadline.

2|34|Clock pieces|碎成三块的钟面|钟面1到12分成三块，每块数字和相等，不能用奇形怪状的碎片。如何分？|A clock numbered 1–12 breaks into three ordinary-shaped pieces with equal number sums. How can the numbers be grouped?|总和78，每块26；碎片不一定只含圆周上一段连续数字。|The total is 78, so each sum is 26. A piece need not contain only one consecutive arc.|一组为5、6、7、8；另一组为11、12、1、2；第三组为3、4、9、10，均为26。用两条平行切线把钟面分成三条带即可实现。|Use groups {5,6,7,8}, {11,12,1,2}, and {3,4,9,10}, each totaling 26. Two parallel cuts through the face can realize the three bands. Assuming every piece must contain a single consecutive arc is an unnecessary restriction.

2|34|Missing integers|找出缺失的两个数|1到100中缺少两个整数，如何在线性时间找出它们？|Two integers are missing from 1 through 100. How can you recover them in linear time?|同时利用和与平方和。|Use both the sum and the sum of squares.|用完整集合的和减实际和得到s=x+y，用平方和之差得到q=x²+y²。于是xy=(s²−q)/2，解方程t²−st+xy=0即可。扫描一次，时间O(n)、额外空间O(1)；实现时注意整数溢出。|Subtract observed sums from known totals to get s=x+y and q=x²+y². Then xy=(s²−q)/2, and x,y are roots of t²−st+xy=0. This needs one pass and constant extra space; use sufficiently wide integers.

2|35|Counterfeit coins I|一次称出假币袋|10袋各100枚币，一袋每枚重9克或11克，其余每枚10克。如何只称一次确定假币袋？|Ten bags contain 100 coins each. One bag has coins weighing 9 or 11 grams instead of 10. Identify it with one digital weighing.|让每袋取出的枚数编码袋号。|Encode the bag number in the number of sampled coins.|第i袋取i枚，共55枚。正常总重550克。实测与550的差为±i克，绝对值就是假币袋号，符号判断偏轻或偏重。|Take i coins from bag i, for 55 coins total. The normal reference weight is 550 grams. A measured deviation of ±i grams identifies bag i, with the sign indicating light or heavy coins.

2|35|Glass balls|两枚鸡蛋与百层楼|两枚相同玻璃球，存在首次摔碎楼层X。100层楼最坏情况下最少扔几次？|Two identical glass balls break at or above an unknown threshold X. For 100 floors, minimize the worst-case number of drops.|反过来问：两个球、n次机会，最多覆盖多少层？|Reverse the question: how many floors can two balls and n drops cover?|若第一次在k层，碎后只剩1球、n−1次，需要逐层检查k−1层，故k≤n。没碎则最多消除下面n层，上面还能覆盖F(n−1)层。因此F(n)≤n+F(n−1)。从n层开始，按n−1、n−2…递减步长确实能达到上限，故F(n)=n(n+1)/2。13次覆盖91层，14次覆盖105层，答案14。|If the first drop is at k, a break leaves one ball and n−1 drops to check k−1 lower floors, so k≤n. A non-break then leaves at most n confirmed floors plus F(n−1) further floors. Thus F(n)≤n+F(n−1). Drops with decreasing increments n,n−1,… attain the bound, giving F(n)=n(n+1)/2. Since 91<100≤105, the minimum is 14.

2|37|Matching socks|抽屉里的袜子|抽屉里有两种颜色的袜子，黑暗中至少拿几只才能确保一双同色？|A drawer contains socks of two colors. How many blind draws guarantee a matching pair?|把颜色看成两个抽屉。|Treat the two colors as pigeonholes.|最坏前两只颜色不同，第3只必与其中一只同色。因此答案3。一般k种颜色，k+1只保证一对；保证数量和平均数量是不同问题。|The first two can differ; the third must match one. Three socks guarantee a pair. More generally k+1 socks guarantee a match among k colors. This is a worst-case guarantee, not an expected draw count.

2|37|Handshakes|相同握手次数|你和25位同事聚会，所有人都和你握手，其他人也可能互相握手。能保证有人握手次数相同吗？|At a party with you and 25 colleagues everyone shakes your hand; others may shake too.
